A.title: PENUMBRA (DRAFT)
A.line: big rough stones under a long diagonal shadow with a soft edge, block after block; pebbles on the floor each with a short shadow -- UMBRA PLATEAU's long shadow, in raw rock (draft 1's last light along the brink read as the stack's gold pins: dropped)

B.title: TERRACES (DRAFT)
B.line: every face cut in strata that step up the wall, light on one side of each joint and shadow on the other -- a stair of light climbing; the floor in shallow step edges

C.title: DUSK GLASS (DRAFT)
C.line: dark volcanic glass in big facets, each in shadow but for a lit upper-left rim; the floor fractured -- the darkest, value only, no accent
